en.title: Marvel Tōkon Beta Drops July 24: 16 Heroes Ready to Rumble
en.summary: Get your controllers ready! The highly anticipated **Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls** is offering players a chance to jump into the action early with an open beta. This is your first substantial taste of the 4v4 tag-team fighter before its full release.
en.body:
The wait is nearly over for fans eager to unleash devastating combos with their favorite Marvel heroes in **Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls**. The game’s open beta is set to launch on Friday, July 24, 2026, and will run through Sunday, July 26, giving players across PS5 and PC a full weekend to dive into the fray. This is a significant opportunity, especially for PC players, as previous tests were exclusive to PlayStation 5.

Developed by PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works, and Marvel Games, **Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls** promises a vibrant 4v4 tag-team fighting experience. The upcoming open beta will feature a substantial portion of the game’s roster, with 16 out of the 20 confirmed characters available for play. While this means a few fan-favorite heroes will be held back for the full launch, it’s more than enough to showcase the game’s potential and provide diverse team-building opportunities. Players can expect to see iconic Avengers like Captain America, Iron Man, and Black Panther, alongside formidable X-Men such as Storm, Magik, and Wolverine. The Guardians of the Galaxy are also well-represented, with Spider-Man (Miles Morales), Ms. Marvel, and Star-Lord ready for action, joined by Peni Parker and Samurai Outriders. Even Blade makes an appearance, hinting at the diverse roster that awaits.

## What to Expect in the Beta

The **Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls** open beta is designed to give players a robust preview of what’s to come, far exceeding the content offered in previous closed tests. While the full roster of 20 characters won't be present, the 16 playable fighters offer a deep pool for experimentation. This includes a significant chunk of the Avengers team, with the notable absence of the Hulk, whose immense power will surely be a key factor in the final game. The X-Men and Guardians of the Galaxy also have strong showings, ensuring a variety of playstyles and team compositions are available from the outset. Players will be able to download the beta client on Steam or the Epic Games Store for PC, and directly on PlayStation 5, up to two hours before the playtest officially begins.

## Community Anticipation and What's Next

The announcement of the open beta dates has generated considerable excitement within the fighting game community and among Marvel fans worldwide. This beta is a crucial step for developers to gather feedback and stress-test servers before the official launch. The opportunity to play with such a diverse roster, including characters from different corners of the Marvel universe, allows fans to strategize and anticipate dream team-ups. The game is slated for a full release on August 6, 2026, on PS5 and PC. This beta period is the last major chance for players to get hands-on with **Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls** before it hits store shelves, making it an unmissable event for anyone looking forward to this electrifying new fighting game.

content_raw: I'm not usually a fighting game person , but Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls is my jam. Partly because it's superheroes, partly because it looks absolutely beautiful. And with the Marvel Tōkon beta dates coming up, our chance to finally play it is almost here—the previous playtest was exclusive to PS5, the greedy buggers. Below, I'll go over when you can websling into the open beta and what you can expect to have access to. While the full release is only a month away, this beta doesn't reveal everything you'll find on launch day. For one, we're missing a few fighters. When is the Marvel Tōkon beta? The Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls beta runs for just three days on PC and PS5, from Friday, July 24, until Sunday, July 26 , at the following times across the globe: Time Zone Start End US Pacific 12:00 am PT 11:59 pm PT US Eastern 3:00 am ET 2:59 am ET UK 8:00 am BST 7:59 am BST (July 27) Europe 9:00 am BST 8:59 am BST (July 27) Australia 5:00 pm AEST 4:59 pm AEST (July 27) New Zealand 7:00 pm NZST 6:59 pm NZST (July 27) Japan 4:00 pm JST 3:59 pm JST You'll be able to download the open beta via Steam or the Epic Games Store on PC, or on PlayStation, up to two hours before the playtest goes live. What's in the Marvel Tōkon beta? While the open beta features much more content than any previous closed test (which were also limited to PS5), it's still not everything we'll have access to at launch. Most notably, it includes 16 of the 20 characters, so a few teams are a little short-staffed: Fighting Avengers The Avengers are only missing the Hulk, though he's quite a big ally to lose: Captain America Iron Man Black Panther Unbreakable X-Men Storm Magik Wolverine Danger Amazing Guardians Spider-Man Ms. Marvel Star-Lord Peni Parker Samurai Outriders While it's the first time Blade's playable, this team is missing Deadpool and Loki: Ghost Rider Blade Knights of Doom We can playtest my favourite fighters on this team, but it's without Carnage: Doctor Doom Magneto Green Goblin Outside of the almost complete roster, there will be: Six stages We'll also be able to duke it out on six different stages, though the developer hasn't confirmed how many there are in the full game yet: Marvel’s New York (Day) Marvel’s New York (Night) Savage Land X-Mansion Knowhere Wakanda Casual and ranked Surprisingly, we'll be able to check out the ranked mode during the beta, including climbing the ladder. Ironically, it's probably going to be the best time for it, while most players haven't got the knack of how to kick your ass so cleanly you can't react. Open Lobby We'll also have access to the Open Lobby between matches, where you can select an avatar and meet up with other players. You can even challenge them directly by using the arcade cabinets. Episode mode For the first time, we can play through the first three chapters of the story mode. Specifically, the Amazing Guardians storyline, as Spider-Man is putting together the team.
